description: Address ranges of one family that a RoutingPolicy term matches routes against: entries in order, the first that matches a route deciding.

entries.description: Entries in order; a route no entry matches does not match the list.

action.description: Whether a route the entry matches matches the list.

ge.description: Shortest prefix length of a route within `prefix` that the entry matches, from the prefix's length; null matches `prefix` alone, unless `le` is given.

le.description: Longest prefix length of a route within `prefix` that the entry matches; null matches `prefix` alone, unless `ge` is given.

x-chalkos-rules.description: A PrefixList's entries match apart: no two have one prefix, ge and le.
x-chalkos-rules.messageExpression: cel.bind(d, self.filter(e, !self.exists_one(x, cidr(x.prefix) == cidr(e.prefix) && x.ge == e.ge && x.le == e.le))[0], "two entries match " + string(cidr(d.prefix)) + (d.ge != null ? " ge " + string(d.ge) : "") + (d.le != null ? " le " + string(d.le) : "") + ", and the later never decides; drop one")
x-chalkos-rules.rule: self.all(e, self.exists_one(x, cidr(x.prefix) == cidr(e.prefix) && x.ge == e.ge && x.le == e.le))

title: PrefixList

rules.description: A PrefixList's entries are of its family, with ge and le from the prefix length to the family's longest prefix, ge no more than le.
rules.messageExpression: documents.filter(n, cel.bind(s, documents[n].spec, !s.entries.all(e, cel.bind(c, cidr(e.prefix), cel.bind(max, s.family == "ipv4" ? 32 : 128, c.ip(0).family() == s.family && (e.ge == null || e.ge >= c.prefix() && e.ge <= max) && (e.le == null || e.le >= c.prefix() && e.le <= max) && (e.ge == null || e.le == null || e.ge <= e.le)))))).map(n, "PrefixList " + n).join(", ") + " has an entry of another family, or a ge or le outside its range: both lie from the prefix length to 32 for IPv4 or 128 for IPv6, and ge no higher than le"
rules.rule: documents.all(n, cel.bind(s, documents[n].spec, s.entries.all(e, cel.bind(c, cidr(e.prefix), cel.bind(max, s.family == "ipv4" ? 32 : 128, c.ip(0).family() == s.family && (e.ge == null || e.ge >= c.prefix() && e.ge <= max) && (e.le == null || e.le >= c.prefix() && e.le <= max) && (e.ge == null || e.le == null || e.ge <= e.le))))))
